incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: In trace 1e1ca74ce064ff7b8db8dc055f1388d6 (started 2026-11-03T12:14:50), checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span (span_id 29195fc0d53859fa, service checkout v2.0.2) recorded status ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'.

Checkout's outbound client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span_id a878972a927083ad, parent 29195fc0d53859fa, same trace 1e1ca74ce064ff7b8db8dc055f1388d6) is the only erroring dependency call from checkout, with rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and otel.status_description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; duration 31,269 us.

The deepest error is in payment itself: its server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span_id 48ef9c6a9d7eb790, service payment v2.0.2, parent a878972a927083ad, trace 1e1ca74ce064ff7b8db8dc055f1388d6, duration 27,950 us) recorded ERROR with exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'.

Within the failing payment Charge span, payment's child span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (span_id ea2077cb9c466306, 18,774 us) and flagd's own flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (span_id 7e0c6a45a42a896c) and resolveFloat (span_id 2af6d6fcde245594) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0, i.e. flag evaluation itself succeeded and flagd returned normally rather than erroring.

Error-status span increases in the last 5 minutes (12:10:26-12:15:26) were 1.25 for checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 1.25 for checkout span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and 1.25 for payment span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, while every other checkout/payment span with an ERROR series sat at 0 (e.g. checkout oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 0, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems 0).

Baseline comparison: over the hour 11:15:26-12:15:26, error-status increases for checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge were 0 in all eleven evaluation buckets before the final one, and only the 12:15:26 evaluation shows 1.25 each; the same holds at 60-second resolution from 11:45:26 to 12:10:26 (all zeros). This is a new, single occurrence rather than a pre-existing error rate.

Feature-flag impression series feature_flag_key=paymentFailure, feature_flag_result_variant='100%' (provider flagd, reason STATIC, service_name flagd) had an increase of 0 in every 5-minute bucket from 11:15:26 through 12:10:26 and first became non-zero (2.5) in the final bucket ending 12:15:26, while the same flag's 'off' variant appeared intermittently through the hour and rose to 7.5 in that final bucket.

No latency elevation in the final window: p95 (traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket) at 12:14:26 was checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 48 ms versus 87.5-182.5 ms at earlier points of the same 11:45-12:15 query, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 3.8 ms, payment 'charge' 3.8 ms, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 1.9 ms, currency Currency/Convert 1.9 ms, cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 4.1 ms, shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 3.9 ms and email POST /send_order_confirmation 46 ms (in line with its own earlier 43-48 ms).

Checkout's dependency calls in the failing request succeeded: checkout oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (span d7c204738f79127d) rpc.grpc.status_code=0, cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (span 1e44e12c32e3f995) and HGET (span a8dcf2289bc874a4) completed, currency Currency/Convert (spans a44f849ebdd6fb21 and 61b608ea79bd7f11) carry otel.status_code=OK, shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote (span 2caca1ba95e828f7) rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with shipping POST http 200, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (span 88de622452f8e373) rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and quote POST /getquote (span 75d2aae935b3d92e) completed, all in trace 1e1ca74ce064ff7b8db8dc055f1388d6.

Checkout is not failing on every request in the sampled window: the same checkout trace sample contains two successful checkouts, trace ea6d4305d3b69364ba15efa70d6c5193 and trace 2b3af483eccd5d62fd220b4dbe3e49de, each with checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code=0, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and HTTP POST 200; in trace ea6d4305d3b69364ba15efa70d6c5193 the email span POST /send_order_confirmation returned http.status_code=200 and send_email completed.

The failure propagated to the edge in the same trace 1e1ca74ce064ff7b8db8dc055f1388d6: frontend-proxy 'ingress' (span 5bdc5e024cf36e9f) and 'router frontend egress' (span e7fdfb37e14da844) recorded http.status_code=500 with error=true, frontend POST (span b802ee809eebccc1) 500, frontend POST /api/checkout (span c68ea3c0c83d4120) 500, frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' (span d11a7fbff25aabd6) 500 with the 13 INTERNAL message, and load-generator POST (span 921142e771a09593) http.status_code=500.

cart reported zero ERROR-status spans in both the 30-minute (11:45-12:15) whole-window sum (service cart = 0) and the 5-minute window (cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart = 0), and cart's own spans in the failing trace show no error tags.

traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans, not requests: in the last 5 minutes the all-status-code increase for checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder was 1.25, equal to its error-status increase, so the metric supplies no usable success denominator and an exact checkout error ratio cannot be computed from it; the sampled traces themselves show 1 failed and 2 successful checkouts.

Most likely cause supported by the evidence: payment rejected the charge through its own feature-flag-driven failure path. Payment resolved the flagd float flag paymentFailure inside the failing Charge span and the paymentFailure variant '100%' first appeared in the same 5-minute bucket, matching the exception thrown at payment charge.js:37 with message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.'; flagd itself answered with rpc.grpc.status_code=0. Not confirmed: the flag's rule/default configuration, the exact float value returned to that specific evaluation, and any change record are unavailable, so the link between the '100%' variant and this particular throw is inference from co-occurrence plus the error text, not a directly observed value.

Alternative still open: the single rejection could be request-specific, i.e. payment's token/card validation rejecting one request's data ('Invalid token') independently of the paymentFailure variant. Payment logs and the flag value returned for that evaluation are not available, so this cannot be excluded; it is however a single occurrence with no comparable prior occurrence in the sampled hour.

Rejected: the flagd EventStream errors on ad/flagd/recommendation as the cause of the checkout failure. Those ERROR spans are attributed to services flagd, ad and recommendation (ad 6.21, recommendation 3.10, flagd 2.07 error-span increases over the same 30 minutes) and do not appear in trace 1e1ca74ce064ff7b8db8dc055f1388d6; the failing request's flagd evaluation returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and the failure text originates in payment's charge handler, not in a flag stream.

Rejected: latency or saturation in checkout or its dependencies as the cause. p95 for checkout PlaceOrder was 48 ms in the final window against 87.5-182.5 ms at earlier points of the same query, and payment Charge, product-catalog GetProduct, currency Convert, cart GetCart, shipping GetQuote and email POST /send_order_confirmation all stayed at 1.9-46 ms in their own ranges; the failing Charge span took 27,950 us and returned an application-level error message, not a timeout or deadline status.

Rejected: cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping or email failing and thereby breaking PlaceOrder. Inside the failing trace those spans returned non-error status (cart GetCart rpc 0, currency Convert otel.status_code=OK, shipping GetQuote rpc 0 with http 200, product-catalog GetProduct rpc 0, quote /getquote completed), and no ERROR-status series was returned for product-catalog, currency, shipping, email or quote at all in the 5-minute or 1-hour queries.

Counter-evidence to a broad payment outage: only one payment Charge error span was counted (payment total error increase 1.034 over 30 minutes, matching a single span; 1.25 in the 5-minute window), payment's Charge p95 stayed at 3.8 ms, and two sampled checkouts in the same window completed with checkout Charge rpc.grpc.status_code=0, so payment was still successfully charging other requests.

gaps: change_history is not integrated, so I could not confirm when or by what change flagd's paymentFailure flag (or its rule) moved to the '100%' variant; only the first appearance of that variant in the impression metric (final 5-minute bucket) is observed.

The actual float value returned by the ResolveFloat evaluation inside the failing payment Charge span is not visible, and one error-detail field on that span was omitted by the trace projection; flagd impression series carry no per-caller label, so I cannot prove the '100%' evaluation served this specific charge.

The flagd impression label query under the exact label name flag_key returned no_data (view bf4d37ea-7fdc-4e50-8093-cf7a67481ee6-t0:0d2147d8-44ed-4bde-bdfe-7bedbc6745c8), so the available label coverage for feature_flag_flagd_impression_total is not fully known; the flag names used came from the returned series labels feature_flag_key and feature_flag_result_variant rather than from a label-value enumeration.

The metric-name listing view (1c0edd2f-da8c-42ca-b195-b43d3582900e-t0:b3e8e32f-418f-42c8-b430-2f898600a744) was incomplete (100-value limit reached), so other duration or latency series may exist that this Run did not enumerate; only names returned by that view were queried.
pod_logs is not integrated, so payment's charge.js path (token validation vs flag threshold) could not be read directly; the mechanism remains a hypothesis.
kubernetes_state is not integrated, so pod/deployment readiness, restarts or image changes for checkout, payment or flagd could not be checked.

The trace evidence is sampled and sliced: the checkout result exceeded the view limit and the read slice was truncated (view f244ce63-7e6e-4254-90ac-13f29faeae25-t0:3e399409-135e-43ba-bc37-78b23fa985c1 shows 60 of 121 rows, 61 rows omitted), so failing vs successful checkout counts are lower bounds from the sampled view, and trace span counts are not unique request counts.
Whether the failure recurred after 12:15:26 (end of the authorized window's final 5 minutes) is unknown.
I did not investigate the separate flagd EventStream ERROR spans on ad, flagd and recommendation beyond establishing they are not in the failing checkout trace; their own impact is unknown.
next_steps: Inspect the flagd flag configuration for paymentFailure (current variant/percentage and any change record) to confirm whether the '100%' variant was set intentionally around 12:14-12:15 on 2026-11-03.
If the flag change was not intentional, revert paymentFailure to a lower/off variant and re-observe checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error spans and frontend POST /api/checkout HTTP 500s.
Review payment service logs for charge.js:37 decisions around 2026-11-03T12:14:50 to distinguish flag-driven failure injection from a genuinely invalid token.
Re-run the same 5-minute error and p95 queries after any change to confirm the checkout error span and the 500s stop, since the last observed data points are 12:14:26 and 12:14:50.
report_parsed.summary: Checkout's error signal is real but low-volume: in the last 5 minutes (12:10:26-12:15:26) exactly one failing checkout request appears, trace 1e1ca74ce064ff7b8db8dc055f1388d6, where checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span recorded ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and status description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'. The deepest error is inside payment: its server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service payment v2.0.2, span 48ef9c6a9d7eb790) threw from payment's own code ('module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)') and returned gRPC UNKNOWN(2) to checkout, which surfaced as INTERNAL(13) and HTTP 500 at frontend, frontend-proxy and the load-generator. Checkout's other dependency calls in that same request (cart GetCart/HGET, currency Convert with otel.status_code=OK, shipping GetQuote, product-catalog GetProduct, quote /getquote) all succeeded with non-error status. Error-status span increases for checkout PlaceOrder, checkout's PaymentService/Charge client span and payment's Charge server span were 1.25 at the 12:15:26 evaluation and 0 at every evaluation point over the preceding hour, so this is a new occurrence rather than a sustained high rate; the metric counts spans, not requests, so no exact error ratio is derivable. Latency was not elevated in the final window for checkout PlaceOrder (p95 48 ms at 12:14:26 vs 87.5-182.5 ms at earlier points of the same query) or for payment Charge and the dependencies, so failures are not accompanied by elevated latency. The strongest supported cause is payment's feature-flag-driven failure path: the failing Charge span contains a child ResolveFloat call to flagd that returned OK, and the flagd impression series feature_flag_key=paymentFailure first shows the variant '100%' in the same final 5-minute bucket (0 in all earlier buckets over the hour). A request-specific invalid-token rejection remains an open alternative because flag configuration, payment logs and change history are not available.
